So? That’s a weird follow up to your tweet. I mean the shift against Wilson in the last decade is not primarily about his foreign policy (though I am happy to criticize his foreign policy). 

Did you miss all the stuff about his racism? His regret that the South lost the Civil War, his resegregation of the federal government? What’s your defense of the American Protective League and the Committee for Public Information? Paramilitary fascisti and a ministry of propaganda respectively?  What about
“Good morning. It’s Tuesday. It’s going to be very hot today. Try to put your belly on something cool. Also, I love you.”

I do wish the broader left that dismisses this evil stuff could understand that it is as provocative as any of the rhetoric they deplore from the right and as morally indefensible.


Molly Crane-Newman (@molcranenewman)
